traits.fruit_type.note: Britton and Brown, Illustrated Flora, 2nd ed. vol. 2 (1913), Celastrus (genus account), p. 493 (read on the Internet Archive, 2026-10-17): capsule 2-4-celled, opening loculicidally into as many valves, the seeds in a scarlet aril.

traits.sexual_system.note: Gray's New Manual, 7th ed. (1908), Celastrus, p. 557 (read on the Internet Archive, 2026-10-17): polygamo-dioecious; Britton and Brown (vol. 2 p. 493): dioecious or polygamous; Bailey (vol. 2 p. 700): polygamous.
